about.title: Over thirty years in one complicated subject.
about.lead1: Decker Pex Levi practises immigration, visa and citizenship law from offices in Tel Aviv and Jerusalem, and has ranked repeatedly among the leading Israeli firms in the field. Clients are individuals and families seeking a foreign passport, immigrants and emigrants, and international companies that need legal solutions in Israel.
about.lead2: We undertake only cases with a solid foundation and a reasonable chance of success, then guide each client from the first consultation to the result, with complete transparency and updates throughout.
about.photoAlt: The Decker Pex Levi team at the firm's offices

how.title: Any client can, and should, understand what we do.

points.title: You lead, we explain
points.body: From the first meeting we explain how the process works, where it may become complex, and what has to be done. The client leads on their preferences; we make sure the goal is reached in the best way.

points.title: Only cases that can succeed
points.body: We undertake cases with a solid foundation and a reasonable chance of success, and say so plainly when there is none. Once we are in, we see it through, including repeated applications and appeals.

points.title: The whole process
points.body: A one-stop shop from the first meeting to the result, without further action required of the client. On a foreign passport that means obtaining records, translating them, filing, and accompanying you until the passport is in hand.

points.title: Multinational and multicultural
points.body: Attorneys and professionals from many backgrounds, working in Hebrew, English, Russian, Ukrainian, Arabic, German, Dutch and Spanish, so we liaise directly with authorities in Europe, the US, Canada and Israel.

points.title: Informed clients, informed public
points.body: We publish up-to-date legal information on this site, our podcast and our YouTube channel, because anyone who seeks it should be able to understand the law that affects them.

recognition.title: Ranked in <ltr>Dun's 100</ltr> and <ltr>BDI</ltr> among Israel's leading immigration firms.
recognition.body: The ranking reflects the firm's commitment to quality of service and professional vision, and its record of legal solutions in the field, including judgments that set precedent on status and citizenship in Israel.
